# M11-S1/S2: IsZero-only named scalars stay scalar under static JSON
# (r4373037368). A named int/string/bool implementing only IsZero must
# encode as a plain scalar, honor the `string` tag option in both
# directions, consult IsZero for omitzero, and keep custom-marshaler
# precedence. The walk already does this; the generated MarshalJSON and
# UnmarshalJSON must match encoding/json byte for byte. Before the fix
# the static classifier put IsZero-only types in shapeFallback, dropped
# the `string` option on encode (bare scalar) and rejected quoted input
# on decode. This is the first public installed-logos generated
# serializer attack for the finding: it runs the generated methods via
# `logos run` and compares against the reflective oracle in the same
# process, under both default and jsonv2 modes via the parent harness.
# Error parity covers bare unquoted inputs and malformed quoted values
# per kind (int/string/bool readers differ): presence/class plus shared
# Value/Type/Field/Offset with literal per-target Struct roots (Obj vs
# empty anonymous); plain errors compare exact text. The combined `string,omitzero` field,
# pointer fields (nil and non-nil), and pointer-receiver IsZero
# (addressability) are covered as controls that must keep passing.
# Error flow discipline: every fallible call checks its error in explicit
# control flow before its result is read, so the result is never
# observed on the error path.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^encode int ok$'
stdout '^encode string ok$'
stdout '^encode bool ok$'
stdout '^decode quoted ok$'
stdout '^decode bare rejects ok$'
stdout '^decode malformed rejects ok$'
stdout '^decode fatal rejects ok$'
stdout '^omitzero custom ok$'
stdout '^combo string omitzero ok$'
stdout '^pointer string ok$'
stdout '^ptrrecv omitzero ok$'
stdout '^marshaler precedence ok$'
stdout '^numeric parity ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/fallbackstring

go 1.27

require example.com/poracle v0.0.0

replace example.com/poracle => ../poracle

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"example.com/poracle"
)

type ZInt int

func (z ZInt) IsZero() bool { return z == 42 }

type ZString string

func (z ZString) IsZero() bool { return z == "zero" }

type ZBool bool

func (z ZBool) IsZero() bool { return bool(z) }

type Obj struct {
	I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
	S ZString `json:"s,string"`
	B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
}

type OmitObj struct {
	I ZInt    `json:"i,omitzero"`
	S ZString `json:"s,omitzero"`
	B ZBool   `json:"b,omitzero"`
}

type ComboObj struct {
	I ZInt    `json:"i,string,omitzero"`
	S ZString `json:"s,string,omitzero"`
	B ZBool   `json:"b,string,omitzero"`
}

type PtrObj struct {
	P *ZInt? `json:"p,string"`
}

type PZInt int

func (z *PZInt) IsZero() bool { return *z == 7 }

type PZObj struct {
	V PZInt `json:"v,omitzero"`
}

type MInt int

func (m MInt) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { return []byte(`"custom"`), nil }
func (m MInt) IsZero() bool                 { return m == 0 }

type MarshalObj struct {
	V MInt `json:"v,string"`
}

type NumObj struct {
	I int64   `json:"i,string"`
	U uint64  `json:"u,string"`
	F float64 `json:"f,string"`
}

func encodeInt() {
	o := Obj{I: 5, S: "hi", B: true}
	gen, gerr := o.MarshalJSON()
	if gerr != nil {
		panic("gen encode: " + gerr.Error())
	}
	genText := string(gen)
	ref, rerr := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
	}{I: 5, S: "hi", B: true})
	if rerr != nil {
		panic("ref encode: " + rerr.Error())
	}
	refText := string(ref)
	if genText != refText {
		panic("encode int: gen " + genText + " ref " + refText)
	}
	fmt.Println("encode int ok")
}

func encodeString() {
	o2 := Obj{I: 42, S: "zero", B: false}
	gen2, gerr2 := o2.MarshalJSON()
	if gerr2 != nil {
		panic("gen encode2: " + gerr2.Error())
	}
	genText2 := string(gen2)
	ref2, rerr2 := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
	}{I: 42, S: "zero", B: false})
	if rerr2 != nil {
		panic("ref encode2: " + rerr2.Error())
	}
	refText2 := string(ref2)
	if genText2 != refText2 {
		panic("encode string: gen " + genText2 + " ref " + refText2)
	}
	fmt.Println("encode string ok")
}

func encodeBool() {
	o3 := Obj{I: 0, S: "", B: false}
	gen3, gerr3 := o3.MarshalJSON()
	if gerr3 != nil {
		panic("gen encode3: " + gerr3.Error())
	}
	genText3 := string(gen3)
	ref3, rerr3 := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
	}{I: 0, S: "", B: false})
	if rerr3 != nil {
		panic("ref encode3: " + rerr3.Error())
	}
	refText3 := string(ref3)
	if genText3 != refText3 {
		panic("encode bool: gen " + genText3 + " ref " + refText3)
	}
	fmt.Println("encode bool ok")
}

func decodeQuoted() {
	var g Obj
	gderr := g.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"i":"5","s":"\"hi\"","b":"true"}`))
	if gderr != nil {
		panic("decode quoted gen err: " + gderr.Error())
	}
	if g.I != 5 || g.S != "hi" || bool(g.B) != true {
		panic("decode quoted gen value")
	}
	var r struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
	}
	rderr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"i":"5","s":"\"hi\"","b":"true"}`), &r)
	if rderr != nil {
		panic("decode quoted ref err: " + rderr.Error())
	}
	if r.I != g.I || r.S != g.S || r.B != g.B {
		panic("decode quoted parity")
	}
	fmt.Println("decode quoted ok")
}

func decodeBare() {
	bareInputs := []string{
		`{"i":5,"s":"\"hi\"","b":"true"}`,
		`{"i":"5","s":5,"b":"true"}`,
		`{"i":"5","s":"\"hi\"","b":true}`,
	}
	for _, input := range bareInputs {
		var gb Obj
		gberr := gb.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(input))
		if gberr == nil {
			panic("decode bare should reject: " + input)
		}
		var rb struct {
			I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
			S ZString `json:"s,string"`
			B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
		}
		rberr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &rb)
		if rberr == nil {
			panic("decode bare oracle should reject: " + input)
		}
		parityMismatch := poracle.CheckDecodeParity(poracle.ParityRequest{GErr: gberr, RErr: rberr, Input: input, Label: "decode bare", Expected: "Obj"})
		if parityMismatch != "" {
			panic(parityMismatch)
		}
		if gb.I != rb.I || gb.S != rb.S || gb.B != rb.B {
			panic("decode bare value parity: " + input)
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("decode bare rejects ok")
}

func decodeMalformed() {
	malformed := []string{
		`{"i":"nul","s":"\"hi\"","b":"true"}`,
		`{"i":"5","s":"nul","b":"true"}`,
		`{"i":"5","s":"\"hi\"","b":"tru"}`,
		`{"i":"","s":"\"hi\"","b":"true"}`,
	}
	for _, input := range malformed {
		var gm Obj
		gmerr := gm.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(input))
		if gmerr == nil {
			panic("decode malformed should reject: " + input)
		}
		var rm struct {
			I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
			S ZString `json:"s,string"`
			B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
		}
		rmerr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &rm)
		if rmerr == nil {
			panic("decode malformed oracle should reject: " + input)
		}
		parityMismatch := poracle.CheckDecodeParity(poracle.ParityRequest{GErr: gmerr, RErr: rmerr, Input: input, Label: "decode malformed", Expected: "Obj"})
		if parityMismatch != "" {
			panic(parityMismatch)
		}
		if gm.I != rm.I || gm.S != rm.S || gm.B != rm.B {
			panic("decode malformed value parity: " + input)
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("decode malformed rejects ok")
}

func decodeFatal() {
	fatalInput := `{"i":"x","s":"\"hi\"","b":"true"}`
	var gf Obj
	gferr := gf.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(fatalInput))
	if gferr == nil {
		panic("decode fatal should reject")
	}
	var rf struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string"`
	}
	rferr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(fatalInput), &rf)
	if rferr == nil {
		panic("decode fatal oracle should reject")
	}
	fatalMismatch := poracle.CheckDecodeParity(poracle.ParityRequest{GErr: gferr, RErr: rferr, Input: fatalInput, Label: "decode fatal", Expected: "Obj"})
	if fatalMismatch != "" {
		panic(fatalMismatch)
	}
	fmt.Println("decode fatal rejects ok")
}

func omitZero() {
	omit := OmitObj{I: 42, S: "zero", B: true}
	gomit, gomitErr := omit.MarshalJSON()
	if gomitErr != nil {
		panic("omit gen err: " + gomitErr.Error())
	}
	gomitText := string(gomit)
	romit, romitErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,omitzero"`
		S ZString `json:"s,omitzero"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,omitzero"`
	}{I: 42, S: "zero", B: true})
	if romitErr != nil {
		panic("omit ref err: " + romitErr.Error())
	}
	romitText := string(romit)
	if gomitText != romitText {
		panic("omitzero custom: gen " + gomitText + " ref " + romitText)
	}
	keep := OmitObj{I: 0, S: "", B: false}
	gkeep, gkeepErr := keep.MarshalJSON()
	if gkeepErr != nil {
		panic("keep gen err: " + gkeepErr.Error())
	}
	gkeepText := string(gkeep)
	rkeep, rkeepErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,omitzero"`
		S ZString `json:"s,omitzero"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,omitzero"`
	}{I: 0, S: "", B: false})
	if rkeepErr != nil {
		panic("keep ref err: " + rkeepErr.Error())
	}
	rkeepText := string(rkeep)
	if gkeepText != rkeepText {
		panic("omitzero keep: gen " + gkeepText + " ref " + rkeepText)
	}
	fmt.Println("omitzero custom ok")
}

func comboStringOmitZero() {
	combo := ComboObj{I: 42, S: "zero", B: true}
	gcombo, gcomboErr := combo.MarshalJSON()
	if gcomboErr != nil {
		panic("combo gen err: " + gcomboErr.Error())
	}
	gcomboText := string(gcombo)
	rcombo, rcomboErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string,omitzero"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string,omitzero"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string,omitzero"`
	}{I: 42, S: "zero", B: true})
	if rcomboErr != nil {
		panic("combo ref err: " + rcomboErr.Error())
	}
	rcomboText := string(rcombo)
	if gcomboText != rcomboText {
		panic("combo custom: gen " + gcomboText + " ref " + rcomboText)
	}
	comboKeep := ComboObj{I: 0, S: "", B: false}
	gcomboKeep, gcomboKeepErr := comboKeep.MarshalJSON()
	if gcomboKeepErr != nil {
		panic("combo keep gen err: " + gcomboKeepErr.Error())
	}
	gcomboKeepText := string(gcomboKeep)
	rcomboKeep, rcomboKeepErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string,omitzero"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string,omitzero"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string,omitzero"`
	}{I: 0, S: "", B: false})
	if rcomboKeepErr != nil {
		panic("combo keep ref err: " + rcomboKeepErr.Error())
	}
	rcomboKeepText := string(rcomboKeep)
	if gcomboKeepText != rcomboKeepText {
		panic("combo keep: gen " + gcomboKeepText + " ref " + rcomboKeepText)
	}
	comboQuoted := ComboObj{I: 5, S: "hi", B: true}
	gcomboQuoted, gcomboQuotedErr := comboQuoted.MarshalJSON()
	if gcomboQuotedErr != nil {
		panic("combo quoted gen err: " + gcomboQuotedErr.Error())
	}
	gcomboQuotedText := string(gcomboQuoted)
	rcomboQuoted, rcomboQuotedErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		I ZInt    `json:"i,string,omitzero"`
		S ZString `json:"s,string,omitzero"`
		B ZBool   `json:"b,string,omitzero"`
	}{I: 5, S: "hi", B: true})
	if rcomboQuotedErr != nil {
		panic("combo quoted ref err: " + rcomboQuotedErr.Error())
	}
	rcomboQuotedText := string(rcomboQuoted)
	if gcomboQuotedText != rcomboQuotedText {
		panic("combo quoted: gen " + gcomboQuotedText + " ref " + rcomboQuotedText)
	}
	fmt.Println("combo string omitzero ok")
}

func pointerString() {
	nilPtr := PtrObj{P: nil}
	gnil, gnilErr := nilPtr.MarshalJSON()
	if gnilErr != nil {
		panic("ptr nil gen err: " + gnilErr.Error())
	}
	gnilText := string(gnil)
	rnil, rnilErr := poracle.MarshalNil()
	if rnilErr != nil {
		panic("ptr nil ref err: " + rnilErr.Error())
	}
	rnilText := string(rnil)
	if gnilText != rnilText {
		panic("ptr nil: gen " + gnilText + " ref " + rnilText)
	}
	pv := ZInt(5)
	fullPtr := PtrObj{P: &pv}
	gfull, gfullErr := fullPtr.MarshalJSON()
	if gfullErr != nil {
		panic("ptr full gen err: " + gfullErr.Error())
	}
	gfullText := string(gfull)
	rfull, rfullErr := poracle.MarshalFull(poracle.PInt(5))
	if rfullErr != nil {
		panic("ptr full ref err: " + rfullErr.Error())
	}
	rfullText := string(rfull)
	if gfullText != rfullText {
		panic("ptr full: gen " + gfullText + " ref " + rfullText)
	}
	var gp PtrObj
	gpderr := gp.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"p":"5"}`))
	if gpderr != nil {
		panic("ptr decode gen err: " + gpderr.Error())
	}
	decodedPointer := gp.P
	if decodedPointer == nil {
		panic("ptr decode nil")
	}
	if *decodedPointer != 5 {
		panic("ptr decode gen value")
	}
	fmt.Println("pointer string ok")
}

func ptrRecvOmitZero() {
	pzOmit := PZObj{V: 7}
	gpz, gpzErr := pzOmit.MarshalJSON()
	if gpzErr != nil {
		panic("ptrrecv gen err: " + gpzErr.Error())
	}
	gpzText := string(gpz)

		V PZInt `json:"v,omitzero"`
	}{V: 7})
	if rpzErr != nil {
		panic("ptrrecv ref err: " + rpzErr.Error())
	}
	rpzText := string(rpz)
	if gpzText != rpzText {
		panic("ptrrecv omit: gen " + gpzText + " ref " + rpzText)
	}
	pzKeep := PZObj{V: 0}
	gpzKeep, gpzKeepErr := pzKeep.MarshalJSON()
	if gpzKeepErr != nil {
		panic("ptrrecv keep gen err: " + gpzKeepErr.Error())
	}
	gpzKeepText := string(gpzKeep)
	rpzKeep, rpzKeepErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		V PZInt `json:"v,omitzero"`
	}{V: 0})
	if rpzKeepErr != nil {
		panic("ptrrecv keep ref err: " + rpzKeepErr.Error())
	}
	rpzKeepText := string(rpzKeep)
	if gpzKeepText != rpzKeepText {
		panic("ptrrecv keep: gen " + gpzKeepText + " ref " + rpzKeepText)
	}
	fmt.Println("ptrrecv omitzero ok")
}

func checkNumericValues(g NumObj, r NumObj, input string) {
	if g.I != r.I {
		panic("numeric I parity: " + input)
	}
	if g.U != r.U {
		panic("numeric U parity: " + input)
	}
	gNaN := math.IsNaN(g.F)
	rNaN := math.IsNaN(r.F)
	if gNaN != rNaN {
		panic("numeric F NaN parity: " + input)
	}
	if gNaN {
		return
	}
	if g.F != r.F {
		panic("numeric F parity: " + input)
	}
	if math.Signbit(g.F) != math.Signbit(r.F) {
		panic("numeric F sign parity: " + input)
	}
}

func checkNumericRow(input string) {
	var gn NumObj
	gerr := gn.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(input))
	var rn struct {
		I int64   `json:"i,string"`
		U uint64  `json:"u,string"`
		F float64 `json:"f,string"`
	}
	rerr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &rn)
	mismatch := poracle.CheckDecodeParity(poracle.ParityRequest{GErr: gerr, RErr: rerr, Input: input, Label: "numeric", Expected: "NumObj"})
	if mismatch != "" {
		panic(mismatch)
	}
	if (gerr == nil) != (rerr == nil) {
		panic("numeric presence: " + input)
	}
	rVals := NumObj{I: rn.I, U: rn.U, F: rn.F}
	checkNumericValues(gn, rVals, input)
}

func decodeNumeric() {
	numericInputs := []string{
		`{"i":"+5","u":"5","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"05","u":"5","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"-0","u":"5","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":" 5","u":"5","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"0x5","u":"5","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"9223372036854775808","u":"5","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"5","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"05","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"-1","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"18446744073709551615","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"18446744073709551616","f":"1.5"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"5","f":"+5"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"5","f":"NaN"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"5","f":"+Inf"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"5","f":"-Inf"}`,
		`{"i":"5","u":"5","f":"1e1000"}`,
	}
	for _, input := range numericInputs {
		checkNumericRow(input)
	}
	fmt.Println("numeric parity ok")
}

func marshalerPrecedence() {
	m := MarshalObj{V: 5}
	gm, gmErr := m.MarshalJSON()
	if gmErr != nil {
		panic("marshal gen err: " + gmErr.Error())
	}
	gmText := string(gm)
	rm, rmErr := json.Marshal(struct {
		V MInt `json:"v,string"`
	}{V: 5})
	if rmErr != nil {
		panic("marshal ref err: " + rmErr.Error())
	}
	rmText := string(rm)
	if gmText != rmText {
		panic("marshaler precedence: gen " + gmText + " ref " + rmText)
	}
	if gmText != `{"v":"custom"}` {
		panic("marshaler precedence bytes: " + gmText)
	}
	fmt.Println("marshaler precedence ok")
}

func main() {
	encodeInt()
	encodeString()
	encodeBool()
	decodeQuoted()
	decodeBare()
	decodeMalformed()
	decodeFatal()
	omitZero()
	comboStringOmitZero()
	pointerString()
	ptrRecvOmitZero()
	marshalerPrecedence()
	decodeNumeric()
}

-- poracle/go.mod --
module example.com/poracle

go 1.27

-- poracle/poracle.go --
package poracle

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strconv"
)

// ParityRequest groups decode parity inputs so helpers stay within the
// parameter limit. Expected names the generated root (Obj or NumObj);
// the oracle root stays anonymous empty.
type ParityRequest struct {
	GErr     error
	RErr     error
	Input    string
	Label    string
	Expected string
}

// CheckDecodeParity compares a generated decode error against the
// anonymous-struct oracle decode error for the same input. It returns ""
// on parity and a mismatch description otherwise, so .lgo callers keep a
// thin assert without nullable-pointer narrowing. Structured
// *json.UnmarshalTypeError facts compare shared Value, Type, Field and
// Offset, with per-target Struct root asserted literally against
// Expected versus empty anonymous; genuinely plain errors compare
// exact text.
func CheckDecodeParity(r ParityRequest) string {
	if r.GErr == nil && r.RErr == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if r.GErr == nil {
		return r.Label + " presence: gen success ref " + r.RErr.Error() + " input " + r.Input
	}
	if r.RErr == nil {
		return r.Label + " presence: gen " + r.GErr.Error() + " ref success input " + r.Input
	}
	return checkParityErrors(r)
}

func checkParityErrors(r ParityRequest) string {
	var gUTE *json.UnmarshalTypeError
	var rUTE *json.UnmarshalTypeError
	gIsUTE := errors.As(r.GErr, &gUTE)
	rIsUTE := errors.As(r.RErr, &rUTE)
	if gIsUTE != rIsUTE {
		return r.Label + " error class: gen " + r.GErr.Error() + " ref " + r.RErr.Error() + " input " + r.Input
	}
	if !gIsUTE {
		if r.GErr.Error() != r.RErr.Error() {
			return r.Label + " message: gen " + r.GErr.Error() + " ref " + r.RErr.Error() + " input " + r.Input
		}
		return ""
	}
	return checkParityFacts(gUTE, rUTE, r)
}

func checkParityFacts(gUTE *json.UnmarshalTypeError, rUTE *json.UnmarshalTypeError, r ParityRequest) string {
	if gUTE == nil {
		return r.Label + " gen UTE nil: " + r.Input
	}
	if rUTE == nil {
		return r.Label + " ref UTE nil: " + r.Input
	}
	if gUTE.Struct != r.Expected {
		return r.Label + " gen Struct: got " + gUTE.Struct + " want " + r.Expected + " input " + r.Input
	}
	if rUTE.Struct != "" {
		return r.Label + " ref Struct: got " + rUTE.Struct + " want empty input " + r.Input
	}
	if gUTE.Field != rUTE.Field {
		return r.Label + " field: gen " + gUTE.Field + " ref " + rUTE.Field + " input " + r.Input
	}
	if gUTE.Value != rUTE.Value {
		return r.Label + " value: gen " + gUTE.Value + " ref " + rUTE.Value + " input " + r.Input
	}
	if msg := checkParityType(gUTE, rUTE, r.Input, r.Label); msg != "" {
		return msg
	}
	if gUTE.Offset != rUTE.Offset {
		return r.Label + " offset mismatch: gen " + strconv.FormatInt(gUTE.Offset, 10) + " ref " + strconv.FormatInt(rUTE.Offset, 10) + " input " + r.Input
	}
	return ""
}

func checkParityType(gUTE *json.UnmarshalTypeError, rUTE *json.UnmarshalTypeError, input string, label string) string {
	if gUTE.Type == nil || rUTE.Type == nil {
		if gUTE.Type != rUTE.Type {
			return label + " type nil mismatch input " + input
		}
		return ""
	}
	if gUTE.Type.String() != rUTE.Type.String() {
		return label + " type: gen " + gUTE.Type.String() + " ref " + rUTE.Type.String() + " input " + input
	}
	return ""
}

// PInt mirrors the logos ZInt ground truth in ordinary Go: a named int
// implementing only IsZero. Plain *PInt fields exercise the genuine
// encoding/json nullable-pointer path, which .lgo cannot spell because
// *T there is non-nil.
type PInt int

func (v PInt) IsZero() bool { return v == 42 }

// Ptr mirrors PtrObj with an ordinary Go pointer.
type Ptr struct {
	P *PInt `json:"p,string"`
}

// MarshalNil marshals the nil-pointer control through encoding/json.
func MarshalNil() ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(Ptr{P: nil})
}

// MarshalFull marshals a non-nil pointer through encoding/json.
func MarshalFull(v PInt) ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(Ptr{P: &v})
}
